text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm Sakura Chiyono O! Um, it's my
pleasure to be
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I really look up to Maruzen, and
sometimes I actually entertain the
thought of competing
against her
someday...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And "good things come to those at the
gate"! So
I'll do my very best to get
there myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
